m2_definition.definition: A complete rights-cleared current code-to-locality assignment passes authority, coverage, freshness, licence and digest gates.

review_scope: Bounded public operator search and public catalog metadata inspection, not a national data acquisition or production adapter.

postal_probe.grain: One displayed operator postcode/locality/district/city-or-regency/province tuple; the display ordinal is not a stable source identifier.

catalog_probe.review_notice: Data berikut ini masih dalam proses pemenuhan Prinsip SDI.
catalog_probe.resource_policy: Never follow resource URLs or retrieve restricted data from this catalog. Public page metadata and a visible Download label are not permission. Do not serialize embedded account, contact or credential fields.

promotion_requirements: Keep the pre-existing complete national M2_assignment criterion; limited queries or scoped provincial previews do not satisfy it.
Obtain current complete assignment data from a documented lawful source with source-defined coverage, edition, identifiers and exceptions.
Resolve public-label/access-flag/license contradictions with artifact-specific rights and permitted fields; metadata absence is not an explicit prohibition or a grant.
Pin source and terms SHA-256, observed time, edition and reproducible transformations without inventing valid_from from retrieval or catalog update time.
Keep BPS and Kemendagri identifiers and editions separate; do not join by locality text or treat repeated postal codes as duplicate errors.
After explicit destination approval, publish immutable rights-cleared artifacts outside AGID Git and verify actual AGID loader/API behavior.
M2 assignments can have geometry none; postcode/locality evidence cannot populate street, premise, recipient, building or inferred coordinates.
